Source: https://unpkg.com/three@0.185.1/build/three.core.min.js

Note: the r185 module build is two files. three.module.min.js opens with
"import ... from './three.core.min.js'", so the core chunk must sit
beside it or every import of "three" 404s.

fonts/jetbrains-mono-{400,500}.woff2
    JetBrains Mono 2.211, latin subset.
    Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors.
    SIL Open Font License 1.1.
    https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono
    Vendored 2026-08-16 from @fontsource/jetbrains-mono via jsDelivr;
    byte-identical to its 5.3.0 latin files (checked 2026-10-13).

Both are served from the dashboard itself rather than a font CDN: the
server binds to 127.0.0.1 and is used on machines that are often offline
mid-experiment, and a third-party font request would also disclose when
somebody is looking at a run.
